subject.title: [Security] Missing complexity validation and rate limiting on log query filters

question: Does the ACP threat model require a separate per-client limiter for repeated existing-session replay loads despite the exact-key, size-bounded query contract?
rationale: Source inspection disproves the reported recursive-query mechanism, but deciding whether a locally connected or authenticated ACP client must be constrained from repeatedly requesting bounded replay data is an explicit security-boundary choice.

options.title: Reject the reported mechanism
options.body: Confirm no alternate ingress accepts arbitrary filters and close the report because recursive client-defined SQL conditions are not present.

options.title: Add narrow replay throttling
options.body: Preserve the existing exact-key API but add per-client throttling around repeated session replay loads as defense in depth.

recommendation.title: Reject the reported mechanism
recommendation.body: Confirm no alternate ingress accepts arbitrary filters and close the report because recursive client-defined SQL conditions are not present.
